description: This file manages the dynamic loading of assets (CSS and JS) for Drupal pages using htmx events. It handles request configuration, response parsing, asset injection, and custom event triggering for page load completion.

methods.name: htmx:beforeRequest
methods.description: Handles the 'htmx:beforeRequest' event to initialize asset load promises.

methods.name: htmx:configRequest
methods.description: Configures AJAX request parameters, including adding query parameters for Drupal-specific page state.

methods.name: htmx:beforeHistoryUpdate
methods.description: Cleans URL query parameters before updating browser history.

methods.name: htmx:beforeSwap
methods.description: Parses server response HTML to extract and load assets, and updates Drupal settings.

methods.name: htmx:afterSettle
methods.description: Triggers Drupal page load event after assets are loaded and settled.
